✡️ Israel’s bot arsenal to manage online messaging: Bogus accounts, paid trolls and AI spin Israel has built a massive influence operation , known as ‘hasbara’, that blurs the line between state messaging and supposedly independent public opinion, The Cradle reports. It relies on volunteers, fake identities, private contractors and even campaigns influencing what AI chatbots tell users. The methods have evolved considerably: 🔴 The 2017 Act-IL app—run by the Interdisciplinary Center Herzliya and the Israeli American Council—assigned volunteers missions to amplify selected pro-Israel content and mass-report posts deemed hostile. Organizers acknowledged receiving information from Israeli intel and the military to identify material for reporting 🔴 Post-Oct. 7, 2023, the Words of Iron platform provided ready-made pro-Israel responses, hashtags and automated posting tools (per CTech). It guided users through reporting procedures targeting journalists, academics and Palestinian accounts 🔴 Oct. 2026 probe, ‘Manufacturing the “Great Replacement,” laid bare a covert ad campaign purportedly linked to Israel that pushed anti-Muslim and anti-migrant messages in 30 countries 🔴 FARA disclosures reveal that the digital advertising firm Clock Tower X LLC - created to funnel Israeli state money into American media - received $40.5M through Havas Media Germany for Israel-linked communications work in 2025–2026. Its contract included publishing online material intended to influence how ChatGPT frames responses, alongside search-engine optimization and targeted advertising 👍 Substack | Chat | @geopolitics_prime
